title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.09450v1 的 19 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: Iris-3B给出开放3B pixel-space T2I从256→1024训练与FLUX latent→pixel转换recipe，作者报告OneIG0.540≈QwenImage0.539但GenEval0.798仍低于0.87。关键判断是负结果：去VAE未让depth/restoration prior更优，pixelpatch边界反而留grid；单run/短转换和无Iris latenttwin使结果只支持“此recipe没有优势”，不是否定pixel paradigm。
analysis.motivationZh: 高分辨率 pixel-space diffusion 训练成本高，而且既有 latent-space 模型的能力难以直接复用。需要厘清像素域的训练表示、优化方式和接口转换，才能以可控成本扩展分辨率并迁移现有生成能力。
analysis.methodZh: Iris用16×16pixelpatch、8dual+16singleblocktrunk及四PiThead，冻结Qwen3VL4B文本features；256stage比较v/x及REPA后选择v+DINOv2，后两stage不再REPA，hybridMuon/AdamW训练并SFT。latentKlein4B转换用gainmatchedridgeinputprojection与0.12×trunkLR解决接口不匹配，30kstepPiTconversion作为downstreamparent。depth用matchedsinglepassregression、restoration用HYPIRone-stepfine-tune做pixel/latent比较，公开confounds、patchgrid和selectedqualitatives；release本体有可复核源码。
analysis.experimentsZh: T2Ipretrain真实/合成/渲染text英文pairs；367k256stage/163k512/95k1024/40kSFT，累计约611.8Msampleexposures非uniqueimages。T2Iofficial1024²CFG3/100steps/4samples。depthHypersim:VKITTI9:1、10kstep32batch；Kleinrestorepaired30ksteps，Iris10kEMAdifferentbudget。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告IrisOneIG0.540≈QwenImage0.539，GenEval0.798低于Qwen0.87，LongText0.857vs0.943。（Table2, PDF p.6）；作者报告Kleinpixel/latentDIV2KSSIM0.504/0.557、PSNR20.87/20.99、LPIPS0.274/0.275；IrisSSIM0.481、MUSIQ68.01。（Table6, PDF p.10） 对照范围：官方publishedT2IscoresFLUX/i1/ZImage/Qwen含promptrewriting差异；matchedKleinpixel-vslatent两downstream对照，Iris无latenttwin。convertedT2IGenEval/DPG/FID未测，restoration公共模型去文本条件改变releasedprotocol，不能作公平全方法排名。 消融与诊断：v/xcontrast还改变timestepsdistribution不完全隔离target；REPA/iREPA/DINOv3/SelfFlowmatchedsteps支持该256recipe。ridge/RMSscaledLR小batch8/1kprobes有效，未验证global128；架构效率changes非同消融选择。
analysis.insightZh: 主要贡献为开放3Bpixel-spacepretrainingrecipe、conversioninterfacegain/LR诊断与透明的downstreamnegativeevidence；architecture借PixelDiT/FLUX/PiT而非新fundamentalflow目标。价值是可用foundationprior与对“无VAE一定更细”的实证边界。
analysis.evidenceZh: Iris采用16×16patchhybridtrunk+PiThead，训练256→512→1024并在256使用DINOv2REPA。（Sec.3.2–3.3 Fig.4, PDF pp.4–6）；作者报告releasedcheckpointGenEval0.798/DPG86.52/OneIG0.540，QwenImage0.87/88.3/0.539。（Table2, PDF p.6）；作者报告depthmeanAbsRelIris0.071/latentKlein0.072/converted0.081；Irispatchgridratio1.61–2.25。（Tables4–5, PDF p.9）；作者明确single-run/no significance、conversionprior较弱及Iris无latenttwin，不能隔离所有confounds。（Limitations, PDF pp.10–11）
analysis.caveatZh: Iris没有latenttwin、convertedparent短训练、每downstreamarm单run无significancetest（pp.10–11）。；IrisrestoreEMA/batch/schedule/wavelet/tiling不与Klein匹配；pixelpatch产生边界grid（pp.9–11）。；Iris非generationrawqualitySOTA（p.11）。；核心结论不应推广为pixelspace无潜力；sameData/compute完整pixel-latentpretrainpair缺失。；611.8M是sampleexposure，未公开uniquecorpus规模/细分license边界，不能推断datasetefficiency。；illustratedrestorecrops先看outputs后选择（App.C），非随机质量证明。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 公开pixel-spacefoundationprior及detail/representationboundary能指导visualgeneration和3Dprior选择；这里restoration/depth作为paradigm检验，未添加这些为独立关注方向。
